title: CHAPTER - 2 INMATE POPULATION IN DIFFERENT JAILS An important aspect in Prison administration is the population that the authorities have to handle in the Prisons. A major problem that is being faced in most of the Indian Jails is over crowding of Prisons which leads to inadequate infrastructure facilities and lack of essential services to the Prison inmates. In order to find the relation between the available capacity in the Prisons and the population of Prison inmates, data regarding the population of the inmates for male, female and total is collected from the Prison authorities. The occupancy in any jail would continue to change almost daily because of incoming of new convicts and outgoing of released prisoners. Still an-estimate of average population of the inmates during a given period would serve as a good indicator to determine the Prison
